My Day at School: I go to school from Monday to Friday.
Classes start at eight in the morning.
We have English first, then math.
column3: 第一节是英语,然后是数学。

My Day at School: At twelve, I have lunch with my friends.
column3: 十二点,我和朋友们一起吃午饭。

My Day at School: In the afternoon, we have art and music.
column3: 下午我们上美术课和音乐课。
